title: Where Skin Should Glow
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 08
Where Skin Should Glow

Glow belongs where the skin makes little oil:
around the eyes, high on the cheekbones,
just beneath the inner corners of the eyes,
and at the bridge of the nose, between the brows.

The T-zone is another story.
There, shine is best kept quiet.

Begin with a base that is half-matte, or softly luminous.
Then, a dewy highlighter, placed only where it belongs.

The result is not shine.
It is glow.
